title: [v3-RC3] After upgrade NO APS SELECTED OR PROVIDED RESULT for the first 30 minutes
body:
When upgrading to v3, On the loop tab there was a message "NO APS SELECTED OR PROVIDED RESULT" With my omnipod eros and Oref1. 
After disabling the autosens, it started to work.
When the pump did run for 30 minutes, the autosens could be switched on again.

This was cause by the database being empty and not containing enough BG history to calculate autosens

Suggestions: 
- document to switch it off when upgrading. (However, users might forget to switch it on again)
- Or fix it, let the loop work with autosens suppressed when there is not enough data, and show a notification for the user. And start working with autosens when there is enough data
